items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I got a job down there working at a club right on Central Avenue, and I'll tell you another lady was on the bill -- Ethel Waters was the star attraction.

ctx.x: I got a job down there working at a club right on Central Avenue, and I'll tell you another lady was on the bill -- Ethel Waters was the star attraction. So this could go on. But these things happened. It sounds like fairy tales, but it really happened.
: Ethel Waters had been around a long time, actually, cause she was very big in the mid-twenties.
